rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Adds a semantic understanding layer on top of SQL Server databases, providing AI assistants with 29 tools for schema comprehension, foreign key relationship traversal, and controlled SQL execution. Enforces policy-gated access to prevent unauthorized queries while enabling natural-language exploration of database structure. Runs as a local Python server using stdio transport and connects to SQL Server via environment-configured credentials.
